newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sara Lee cut explained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sara Lee cut explained.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said she reduced her rating on Sara Lee Corp to market outperform, removing it from the recommended list, based on the opinion that the food and consumer products company does not have "much momentum in the core businesses."

"...(U)nit volume is expected to improve only modestly this year and is very lackluster still in (the current first quarter) and we therefore do not see the catalyst needed to expand the stock valuation," Ghez wrote in a report.

-- Ghez maintained her earnings estimates of $2.03 in fiscal 1997 and $2.25 in fiscal 1998, compared with the $1.83 earned in fiscal 1996, saying there was nothing in Sara Lee's September 5 analyst meeting to make her change the estimates.

-- Looking at the fiscal first quarter, Ghez said that bakery volume is expected to be down five percent, meat down one percent, coffee up three to four percent, knitwear up five to eight percent, and hosiery down but less steeply than last year.
